evidence.ACL: The continuity and alignment of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) are preserved.
evidence.MCL: The medial and lateral collateral ligaments, iliotibial tract, quadriceps tendon, and other structures are intact without definite abnormalities
evidence.Medial Meniscus: PD hyperintensities are detected in the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. More in favor of medial meniscus degenerative tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: The lateral meniscus is intact without tear.
evidence.PF OA: Subchondral erosions, subcortical cysts, and cartilage thinning at the lateral patellofemoral joint. Osteoarthritis and advanced chondromalacia is favored.
